items.raw_excerpt: Anthropologists from the Ridington family began working alongside Dane-zaa elders in the 1960s to record traditional songs, oral histories, and everyday life spanning six decades.
items.summary_en: A family of anthropologists gave their archive of songs, oral histories, and daily life records to the Dane-zaa people in northern British Columbia. The collection covers more than sixty years of work that began in the 1960s. The return followed Treaty 8 promises and a long campaign for repatriation.

items.title_en: Six decades of Treaty 8 history returned to Dane-zaa people in northern B.C.

items.raw_excerpt: The 24-hour Pollutant Standards Index (PSI) in the central region entered the unhealthy range at 8pm on Saturday (Sep 26).
items.summary_en: The air quality in Singapore's central region reached the unhealthy range at 8pm on Saturday, September 26. The 24-hour Pollutant Standards Index, or PSI, crossed the line into unhealthy levels. People in the area were advised to limit long outdoor activities.

items.title_en: Haze Returns: Central Singapore Air Turns Unhealthy

items.raw_excerpt: Residents of Cokonyane in Taung say access to water remains a serious concern.
items.summary_en: A water project worth R1.87 billion has been set aside for a small town in South Africa's North West province. Residents of Cokonyane in Taung say getting safe water is still a serious problem for them.

items.raw_excerpt: The Sydney Roosters are through to the NRLW grand final, continuing their perfect season with a 20-10 victory over Canberra.
items.summary_en: The Sydney Roosters beat the Canberra Raiders 20-10 in a semi-final. They stay unbeaten this season and will play in the NRLW grand final. Their opponent will be the winner of the other semi-final.

items.title_en: Roosters Beat Raiders to Reach NRLW Grand Final

items.raw_excerpt: Hyderabad’s 48-hour Ganesh immersion ends peacefully with massive crowds, heavy security, and lessons learned for next year’s festival.
items.summary_en: The 48-hour Ganesh immersion procession in Hyderabad ended with no problems. Very large crowds and heavy security were seen at the event. The organisers said they learned lessons for next year's festival.

items.raw_excerpt: Right by the promenade, the traditional Porto de Pesca de Setúbal serves as the beating commercial heart of the city's maritime identity.
items.summary_en: Setúbal's old fishing port sits beside the waterfront in Portugal. It is still the busiest center of the city's sea trade. Local boats and fish markets keep the area busy every day.
